name: issue-hygiene-reminder
description: Claude Code and Codex hook: before a GitHub issue write (gh issue create/edit/close/comment, gh api on issues, GitHub MCP issue writes), adds a one-paragraph reminder of the issue-hygiene rules. Never blocks.

interface.shortDescription: Reminds the model of the issue-hygiene rules before a GitHub issue write
interface.longDescription: JStar's personal hook plugin: before a GitHub issue write (gh issue create, edit, close or comment, gh api on issues, GitHub MCP issue writes), it adds a one-paragraph reminder of the issue-hygiene rules. It never blocks. Codex loads the default hooks/hooks.json; trust the hook under /hooks.
defaultPrompt: Draft or update a GitHub issue that follows the issue-hygiene rules.
